name: Fast Poisson Disk Sampling (2D)
definition: A point sampling algorithm that generates a set of points within a given domain such that the minimum distance between any two points is at least 'r', using a grid-based rejection system and an active list.
summary: Fast Poisson Disk Sampling (2D) generates uniformly distributed points with blue-noise properties for rendering by using a spatial grid and active list to achieve linear time complexity.
